name: John
prompt:
Create a new clean supplemental head-turn reference strip for the 1965 THE BEATLES TV cartoon, using the ORIGINAL EPISODE FRAMES attached as primary identity evidence and the attached historical model-sheet reproduction for clean linework and costume. NOT Yellow Submarine (1968).
WIDE LANDSCAPE transparent image, one horizontal row of FIVE separated head-and-shoulder portraits of ONE CHARACTER, same head size and same neutral closed-mouth expression. Order from viewer's left to right: (1) pure profile facing SCREEN-LEFT, yaw -90 degrees; (2) three-quarter facing SCREEN-LEFT, yaw -45 degrees; (3) directly FRONT, yaw 0; (4) three-quarter facing SCREEN-RIGHT, yaw +45 degrees; (5) pure profile facing SCREEN-RIGHT, yaw +90 degrees.
CRITICAL: the 45-degree and 90-degree heads MUST be unmistakably different facial projections, not copies. In each 45-degree portrait BOTH eyes and BOTH brows must be present, far eye narrower and closer to nose, near cheek broad, far cheek visible, nose mostly inside the face boundary. In each pure profile ONLY ONE eye and brow is visible, far eye fully occluded, forehead-nose-lips-chin form a clear side silhouette and the near ear is prominent. FRONT has two equal-size eyes and centered nose. Turn the HEAD in 3D geometry; do not merely slide pupils, rotate the flat sprite or change gaze. Maintain identity-specific nose size and jaw silhouette at every yaw.
Use crisp thin black cel-animation outlines, simple flat colors matching the model-sheet reproduction, black hair, peach skin, no shading or gradients, no film grain. No hands, instruments, environments, diving helmets, text, labels, grid lines, logos or signatures. Enough transparent spacing and margins to see each whole hair silhouette and shoulders. This is new AI reference art grounded in screenshots, not archival material.

IDENTITY: John Lennon: broad long U-shaped rounded-square jaw, broad chin and lower cheeks, long thin J-shaped nose; sleepy sideways eyes; black mop-top with relatively square short sideburns. Shirt and narrow dark tie under blue collarless jacket. The first source frame is John alone, front; second is John alone rightward three-quarter; third is John alone leftward three-quarter. John MUST retain a broad massive lower jaw in every angle, never George's narrow pointed chin or Paul's soft compact face.
